compatibility.component_basis: not explicitly stored in either interval; same continuous mad98.prim series and exact schema/grid/channel contract

preprocessing_contract.target_phi: linear-periodic edges over [0,2pi], unique arithmetic cell centres
preprocessing_contract.target_r: geometric edges over [1.1,200], geometric cell centres
preprocessing_contract.target_theta: linear edges over [0,pi], arithmetic cell centres

metadata.block_edge_rule: clamp to edge cell centre; exact shared face chooses highest level then highest stable block id
metadata.warning: Nearest-neighbour AMR regrid is not conservative and does not preserve div(B) to machine precision. Bcc/vel components remain coordinate-basis components.
